title: E-commerce order domain
goal: Model order ownership, catalog references, and pricing dependencies.

rubric.must: A filled composition diamond is at the Order end of the Order–LineItem relationship.
The Order–LineItem relationship visibly shows 1 at Order and 1..* at LineItem.
Customer–Address uses a hollow aggregation diamond at Customer.
Order has a dashed dependency arrow to TaxPolicy.
Class compartments visibly show private and public members with - and + markers.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture omits the required Customer–Address aggregation and Order–TaxPolicy dependency.
